steps:
4. Add IP Addresses
Procedure
Open Navigator.
Expand Tools.
Click Security Console.
Open the Administration tab near the upper section of the page.
Open Location Based Access.
Locate the IP Address entry field in the middle section of the page.
Add the required IP addresses separated by commas.
Click outside the field so the Save button becomes enabled.
Click Save near the upper-right section.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
